newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus car registrations up 1.5 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus car registrations up 1.5 pct in H1.

text.p: Car registrations in Cyprus increased by 1.5 percent in Cyprus in the first half of the year compared to the first half of 1995, official figures released on Friday showed.
The department of statistics and research said 19,077 new registrations were made between January and June as opposed to 18,791 in the corresponding period in 1995.
The registration of saloon cars increased by 19.8 percent.

While the registration of brand new saloon cars declined by 15.8 percent, the registration of second hand cars imported from Asian countries increased 135 percent, reaching 4,761 in the first half of 1996 compared to 2,027 in the first half of 1995.
Registrations of goods conveyance vehicles and motorcycles declined by 10.2 and 21 percent respectively.
